adjudication.evidence: P1 (528–560) shows a sustained N/E/U shift (~+3.4, −1.3, −0.8 MAD) followed by a partial return, but the interior (especially 542–546) contains a much larger, sharp step (P2: ~−7.7, −13.7, −8.6 MAD) that is not reversed and disrupts continuity; P2 is isolated, non-recovering, and coincides with a nuisance step at day 543. Neither interval exhibits a clean opposing return across all axes; physical motion continues post-560 without closure. No genuine temporary platform is supported.
